text:
eli: FYI CI alert — USW3 A10 perf job complaining, p99 increased ~45% after last merge (4852). noticed at 08:10Z.
mahi: saw dashboards too, heatmap shows bursty tails starting exactly at the deploy window.
sam: opened a quick bisect, initial suspect is the kernel picker heuristic changes in runtime/core/kselector.go from 4852.
ci-bot: perf-ci/usw3-a10 #build-7823 completed — p95: 52ms -> 70ms, p99: 120ms -> 175ms (regression).
nora: logs show KV cache eviction rate jumped. maybe prefetch/batching mixing with new selector. short snippet: `kv_evict_rate=350/min` -> normally ~110/min.
zach: network counters also spiked: NIC tx-queue full events increased during the same intervals. could be batching + kernel pick thrashing causing larger bursts.
jess: can we repro locally with a10-l4 profile? I can run a microbench across HW variants (A10/H100/L4) but need a reproducer.
sam: reproducer: `./bench/trace_workload --seq-dist=long --kvcache=true --batching=adaptive` replicates p99 on AWS A10. attaching perf sample:
```
# perf top sample
  23.4% selectKernelForBatch
  18.1% continuousBatcher::flush
  12.7% net_dev_queue
  9.3% kv_cache::evict
```
mahi: that perf stack points at kernel selector thrash + IO backpressure. when selector flips kernels mid-batch it increases tokens per request and IO bursts.
eli: immediate mitigation — hold rollout in USW3 and pause auto-rollout for 4852. can someone file the rollout hold?
ops-bot: rollout_hold created for merge 4852 in clusters: usw3 (A10 pool). Ticket #RI-4321.
jess: while we bisect, I ran a quick patch reverting only the heuristic change, applied to canary in euw2 — p99 returned to baseline within 10 minutes.
sam: confirmed, reverting heuristic reduces KV evict and NIC queue events. Seems regressed logic increases per-batch size under certain latency quantiles.
nora: propose either revert 4852 entirely or land a targeted fix that clamps kernel switches per-interval and adds hysteresis to batching thresholds.
zach: also want to run network perf isolate — noisy neighbor could amplify this in A10 dense host pools. ops, can we pin noisy-host mitigation?
ops-bot: scheduling anti-affinity patch queued for USW3 A10 nodes, but that is medium effort.
eli: ok plan: 1) hold rollouts (done), 2) full revert if we don't have a safe targeted fix in 2 hours, 3) run cross-hw perf matrix (A10/H100/L4) to rule out hardware-only pathologies, 4) open a deeper profiling task for kernel selector and batching interplay.
mahi: I'll keep bisecting to find the minimal diff. if someone can post the bisect command I'll add results: `git bisect start HEAD v1.2.7; git bisect run ./scripts/perf-check.sh --target=usw3-a10`
sam: adding note — watch for flaky CI noise from region-level NIC scheduling. earlier incidents showed similar symptoms when NIC queueing created tail latency.
eli: thanks all. creating tracking issue RI-4322 and linking logs/graphs. please add any short repro notes as replies here. :thumbsup:
